title: Boston: refusing to go on without a salary advance
summary: At B. F. Keith's in Boston the manager refuses a $200 advance to cover a hotel bill, and Bubbles resolves they will not go on.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: I figured it was a bad deal what we got out of it. They said don't mention it to anyone. After I thought it over for a few years. I couldn't think of that in the beginning. However, we didn't mention it to no one and later on I went to execute my position in getting work without Nazarro -- before I went to get work I had another mishap that happened at the B. F. Keith Theater in Boston, Massachusetts, where we were on the bill playing and we needed some money to pay our hotel bill that we didn't have a chance to pay before we left town. So we go to the manager to ask the manager to give us an advance in salary in order to send this back for the rent we owed. So he said, no, but they sent a telegram about the money so that he could know that we owed the money. No one give us the money. So I said, we've got to have the money. So he'd rather not not give us the money, advanced on salary to pay the money and go do it his way. I'd rather get

the money and send it to them because we owe it to them. Okay? He says, he's not going to do it. So, I said, well, we've got to get the money. So I'm going to go to the manager of the theater, so I sent for the manager to come back stage. So the manager sent the Assistant Manager back. So when the Assistant Manager came back, he got the Assistant Manager before I saw him and told him what not to do where I was concerned. And I told him, look, the only way we can get this straightened out is for him to give us -- let us have the advance. We don't need an advance of no more than $200 to straighten it out. It may be less than that. However, the Assistant Manager don't want to do it. The manager don't want to do it. Nazarro don't want to do it, okay?
You were still involved with Nazarro.
